title: Solo golden-dataset profile
description: One hand-graded synthetic user profile for the WP1 eval harness. Each profile carries a full Q1-Q15 response set + optional cv_extract + expected_outputs that define the gold standard for archetype classification, hook insight, first move, and recommended option. See admin/wp1-eval-harness-design.md v1.1 for the design rationale.

profile_id.description: Sequential profile id, GP_001 through GP_035.

label.description: One-line human label for the profile, e.g. 'Senior FP&A lead, FTSE 250 retail, 11 years, fractional CFO bound'.

domain.description: Major domain per Solo Bible §17 domain coverage list. Used by the harness to stratify regression analysis.

archetype_hint.description: The archetype id this profile is designed to classify as. Used as a target reference; the harness will compare the live pipeline's classification against expected_outputs.primary_archetype_id.

Q1.description: Current or most recent job title.

Q3b.description: Employer or organisation type, free text.

Q8.description: Peer perception, what colleagues say you're best at.

Q11.description: Sector and client context, 2-3 most relevant client types + how they buy.

Q13.description: Network size and quality, free text.

cv_extract.description: Optional CV extract for profiles testing the CV-route. Schema mirrors P0 cv_extract.

edge_case_flags.description: Edge-case flags per WP1 design v1.1 §Sub-PR A. Empty array for centre-of-domain profiles.

hook_insight_must_reference.description: Specific phrases / concepts the hook insight MUST mention to count as profile-specific. Driven by Q3b / Q6 / Q11.

hook_insight_must_not_be.description: Generic framings the hook insight MUST NOT collapse into.

recommended_option_must_be_in.description: Set of acceptable business model ids; the recommended option must be one of these.

commercially_distinctive_one_liner.description: One sentence capturing what makes this user commercially distinct from a generalist version of their archetype.

graded_by.description: 'pending' until Bevan reviews; 'bevan' once expected_outputs are locked.

grading_notes.description: Free-text notes from Bevan during review. Captures judgement calls and edge case rationale.
